evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates creating a game with name/description.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from joining (PP-029) and from invite-limit (PP-028); no other story expresses the same invite-by-URL requirement.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates starting a round via entering an item in a multi-line field.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Similar theme to PP-031 (estimators viewing items) but different actor/role and intent; not a duplicate requirement.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from re-estimating earlier items (PP-013) and from CRUD on items (PP-006/7/8).

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique CRUD action (add) compared to edit/delete and import/copy-paste.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique CRUD action (edit) compared to add/delete and import/copy-paste.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique CRUD action (delete) compared to add/edit and import/copy-paste.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-033 which shows estimates only after all have estimated; different business rule/timing.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Different from entering an agreed estimate (PP-012) and from auto-fill when unanimous (PP-011).

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from accepting average (PP-010) and manual entry (PP-012); different rule (unanimity).

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated by PP-010 (average) or PP-011 (auto-fill); manual entry is a separate requirement.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from selecting an item to estimate (PP-005) because it specifically concerns re-estimating previously estimated items.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Related to PP-015 but not the same requirement: import vs manual copy/paste are different mechanisms.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Related to PP-014 but distinct: copy/paste is a different user action than importing.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from viewing/exporting transcripts (PP-017/18/19); browsing games is a different requirement.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from exporting transcripts (PP-018/19) and from browsing games (PP-016).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Different from CSV export (PP-019); format difference is a meaningful requirement difference.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Different from HTML export (PP-018); format difference is a meaningful requirement difference.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from deleting an account (PP-024) and deleting an item (PP-008); different entity and scope.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from login (PP-022), change details (PP-023), delete account (PP-024), and password reminder (PP-026).

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates the login requirement.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from account creation/deletion and password reminder; no duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from deleting a game (PP-020); different object and effect.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: No other story expresses the same timezone-display requirement.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from login/account management; no duplicate requirement elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates choosing the card sequence.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Related to inviting estimators (PP-002) but adds a specific constraint (limit 15), making it a distinct requirement.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from moderator inviting (PP-002); different actor and action.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates this estimator-facing view of the current item.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Similar to PP-004 but different actor/role and purpose; not a duplicate requirement under QUS Unique.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from showing actual estimates (PP-033/036); this is about status/participation visibility.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Contrasts with PP-009 (show early) and is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Substantially the same requirement as PP-041 (change estimate until draw completed); no meaningful difference in actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-039 (scroll back through stories/estimates) and PP-036 (who gave what in current round).

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Different from PP-032 (who has estimated) and PP-033 (reveal timing); focuses on mapping estimator to estimate in current round.

evaluations.evidence: be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-038 which concerns automatic reset behavior.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-037 (starting the timer); adds automatic reset rule.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated by PP-035 (prior estimates per estimator) or moderator transcript viewing (PP-017).

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates this UI consistency requirement.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-034 (change estimate until last person selects card / all shown); same actor and goal with equivalent condition.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates adding participant photos near played cards.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from accessibility (PP-047) and browser compatibility (PP-046); different nonfunctional requirement.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates providing a glossary/definitions list.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates this specific implementation/performance requirement.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from standards compliance (PP-043) and accessibility (PP-047); different requirement focus.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from XHTML/CSS standards (PP-043) and browser compatibility (PP-046).

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates this general responsiveness requirement (even if PP-045 relates, it is a different, specific means).

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates Unicode/language support.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates predictable URL structure.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates custom/nice error pages.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates this anonymization/non-identifiable storage requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates usage metrics reporting.
